task: image referring/reasoning segmentation under false-premise and counterfactual queries
problem: poor candidate localization is not evidence that the referred object is absent
frozen_parent: fresh publicly trained Qwen3-VL-8B-SAMTok interaction step100, NOT retired Faithful

interface.query_state: frozen full image-query prefill representation; not native mask-end state
interface.spatial_evidence: learned query-to-SAM-feature alignment under original human mask supervision
interface.existence: whole-image evidence plus a learnable native binary prior; no candidate mask/quality input
interface.quality: human foreground precision of a native model proposal, not object presence
interface.correction: quality-conditioned bounded prompt residual, zero initialized
interface.native_empty: query/whole-image evidence branch can produce a learned fallback prompt; no irreversible early exit
interface.points: no raw SasP or neutral/padding points injected
interface.initialization: pixel-exact parent predictions required on every selected held-out case

training_labels: original human target masks, ignore masks and official no-target labels only

small_v1_pilot.interpretation: stable but insufficient gain; fixed +/-4 presence prior dominated learned evidence

v2_pilot.presence_prior: learnable positive weight, initialized 0.1; initial native decision preserved
